messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Discharge Summary:

Patient Name: [Redacted]

Date of Admission: [Redacted]

Date of Discharge: [Redacted]

Reason for Admission:
The patient was admitted due to dizziness, fatigue, and increasing abdominal distension.

Hospital Course:
During the hospital stay, the patient was found to have anemia, hypoalbuminemia, and renal failure. Tumor markers were within normal range. A CT scan revealed an extremely large mass occupying most of the abdomen and pelvis, which was ultimately diagnosed as type 1 papillary RCC with nuclear grade 2. The mass was resected after dissecting it free from its attachments. A perforated anterior duodenal ulcer was also noted and repaired. The patient developed intra-abdominal abscess and required drainage and antibiotics in the intensive care unit. Due to ongoing deterioration, comfort care measures were initiated and the patient deceased 1 month later.
Discharge Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Treatment During Hospital Stay:
The patient was started on enteral feeds and underwent surgery for resection of the mass and repair of a perforated anterior duodenal ulcer. The patient also received antibiotics and pressors during the hospital stay.

Follow-up:
The patient is deceased and requires no further follow-up.

Discharge Medications:
N/A

Discharge Condition:
Deceased.

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.
